login.title: Sign in
login.resetDone: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password.
login.inviteOnly: New accounts are invitation-only. Ask an admin for an invitation link.

register.title: Register
register.firstAdmin: The first account becomes admin. After that, registration is invitation-only.
register.viaInvite: New accounts are created through an invitation link. Open the link an admin gave you.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.noMail: Email delivery is not set up on this instance. Ask an admin to give you a new account or a new invitation.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this address, we have sent you a reset link. It is valid for 15 minutes.
forgot.intro: Enter the email address of your account. We will send you a link to set a new password.

reset.invalidText: This link is invalid, has expired or has already been used.
reset.title: Set a new password

consent.granted: Access granted. You can return to the client.
consent.denied: Access denied. The client has been informed (access_denied).
consent.title: Allow access?
consent.unknownClient: Unknown client, not on the allowlist
consent.name: Name
consent.unverifiedName: The name was provided by the client itself and has not been verified. Only allow what you started yourself.
consent.wantsAccess: {client} wants to access your account. Redirecting to {host}.
consent.loopback: The client redirects back to an address on this machine (localhost). That is normal for local tools, but a warning sign for third-party programs.
consent.useTools: Use your enabled upstream tools. Always included.
consent.adminDesc: Create, change and remove upstreams. Secrets stay excluded: you only enter tokens in the web UI.
consent.stayLoggedIn: In addition: stay signed in so the client can renew itself without asking again.
consent.knowClient: I know this client and want to grant it access despite the warning.
consent.revokeHint: You can revoke access at any time under Clients. The token is only valid for this gateway URL.

device.title: Authorize a device
device.intro: Enter the code your terminal or script is showing.
device.invalid: This code is not valid. Check it and try again.
device.expired: This code has expired. Start the login again on your device.
device.notYours: This code belongs to another account or was already looked at there.
device.processed: This code has already been used.
device.onlyIfYours: Only continue if you started this yourself.
device.codeMustMatch: The code on your device must match:
device.approved: Device authorized. You can go back to your terminal.
device.denied: Request denied. The device gets no access.

invite.title: Accept invitation
invite.contactAdmin: Please contact the admin who invited you and ask for a new link.

reasons.expired: This invitation has expired (it was valid for 7 days).
reasons.used: This invitation has already been used.

link.expiresIn: This link expires in {left} min and can only be used once.
link.secretHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again. You can only replace it.
link.afterwards: Afterwards you can switch back to your coding tool and query the status there again.
link.used: This link has already been used.
link.getNew: Ask your coding tool for a new link.

connected.title: Connected
connected.text: The credentials are saved. You can go back to your coding tool.

unsupported.title: Not supported
unsupported.text: This upstream does not support OAuth sign-in.

error.title: Failed
error.text: Sign-in failed. Ask for a new link.

signup.name: Name
signup.inviteFor: The invitation is valid for this address.
